ops.text: 10.3 Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return or make available for export all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems, subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements, and certify such deletion in writing.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have added an exit clause because the Agreement gives us no right to our data back or to migration help on termination (Section 16.5 even cross-refers to a Section 11 that does not exist). This reflects our standard position: up to six months' transition assistance at your then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter; we can work with 90 days of assistance if that suits your delivery model better.
input.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance, data return in machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion.
